health.summary_one: {{formatted}} thing could be better. None of it loses data.

health.about.no_cover: Covers make the library browsable. Upload one on the book's page; the folder stays as it is.

health.foot_other: Showing {{formatted}}. Fixes are saved in AudioSilo; nothing on disk changes.

health.bulkMatch.repickSummary_other: {{formatted}} books can switch to their {{country}} ASIN

activity.description: What your household listens to, and how the server copes.
activity.scope: Everyone · all libraries · times in server time ({{zone}})
activity.range.label: Period
activity.estimated: Includes about {{hours}} estimated from before this server recorded listening sessions: worked out from where each book was left, less what the apps' own history recorded. Estimates count in the totals and top lists, not the day-by-day charts.
activity.empty.title: No listening in this period
activity.empty.body: Charts fill in once people play something. Try a longer period, or check back later.
activity.hours.aria: Listening hours over the period, by person
activity.year.title: The year, day by day
activity.year.aria: Listening hours per day over the last year
activity.heat.hint: Point at a day to see its hours
activity.when.title: When {{name}} listens
activity.when.aria: Listening by hour of day and weekday
activity.when.none: No hourly detail for this period yet.
activity.topBooks.title: Top books
activity.topPeople.title: Top people
activity.heard.title: Most heard
activity.inactive.title_one: {{formatted}} person hasn't been active for 60 days
activity.inactive.title_other: {{formatted}} people haven't been active for 60 days
activity.funnel.title: Started vs finished
activity.dropOff.title: Where people stopped
activity.dropOff.body_one: {{formatted}} person stopped at {{chapter}} and hasn't come back.
activity.dropOff.body_other: {{formatted}} people stopped at {{chapter}} and haven't come back.
activity.playback.title: How it played
activity.playback.aria: Listening by playback: direct or transcoded
activity.playback.note: {{share}} of listening went through the transcoder.
activity.playback.allDirect: Everything played directly, with no transcoding.
activity.apps.title: Apps in use
activity.apps.description: Devices that listened in this period
activity.apps.none: No devices listened in this period.
activity.apps.outdated_one: {{formatted}} device runs an older build than others on its platform.
activity.apps.outdated_other: {{formatted}} devices run older builds than others on their platform.
activity.apps.unknown_one: {{formatted}} device runs an app from before apps named themselves.
activity.apps.unknown_other: {{formatted}} devices run apps from before apps named themselves.
activity.growth.title: Library growth
activity.growth.aria: Books in the collection over the period
activity.growth.none: Not enough history to draw yet.
activity.storage.title: Storage and coverage
live.title: Listening now
live.empty.title: Nobody is listening right now
live.empty.body: When someone plays a book, it shows up here within a few seconds, with the device, the app and how it plays.
live.note: A session closes on its own after 10 minutes without a position update.
sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Every stretch of listening, newest first. Older sessions are summarised by day after the time set in Settings > General (400 days unless changed).
sessions.historyBody: From the app, before sessions were recorded
sessions.empty.title: No sessions yet
sessions.empty.body: Sessions are recorded from the players' progress saves, so they appear once someone listens.
year.title: Year in listening
year.description: A calendar year, told as a story.
year.empty.title: No listening in {{year}}
year.empty.body: Pick another year, or come back once people have listened.
year.fact.streak_one: day in a row, the longest run
year.fact.streak_other: days in a row, the longest run
devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Every paired phone, browser and personal API key. Signing one out leaves the person's other devices signed in.
devices.empty.title: No devices yet
devices.empty.body: A device appears here once someone pairs it with an invite or signs in.
devices.currentHint: You're using this one. Sign out from the account menu instead.
devices.confirm.title: Sign out {{person}}'s {{name}}?
devices.confirm.body: It stops working at once. {{person}}'s other devices stay signed in, and they can pair this one again with an invite.
devices.confirm.keyBody: Anything using this key stops working at once. It can't be restored; the person can create a new one.
progress.dates.title: {{name}}'s dates for {{title}}
progress.dates.description: Dates count in Activity and in the year in listening. Leave one empty to clear it.
progress.dates.notFinished: Mark the book finished to give it a finish date.
progress.dates.future: Dates can't be in the future.
progress.dates.order: The finish date is before the start date.
errors.noAccess: This person can't see that book. Give them access first.
errors.currentDevice: That's the device you're using. Sign out from the account menu instead.
user.year.title: {{name}}'s listening year · {{year}}
user.listening.noSessions: {{name}} hasn't listened since sessions started being recorded.
user.devices.emptyBody: Pair {{name}}'s phone with an invite link or QR code.
settings.savedRestart: Saved. Some of it takes effect when the server restarts.
settings.locked.hint: Change it where it is set: an environment variable wins over this page.
settings.restart.title: Restart AudioSilo to finish applying your changes
settings.restart.body: Saved, and used from the next start: {{list}}. Until then the server keeps its current values.
settings.confirmRestart.title: Save and apply at the next restart?
settings.confirmRestart.body: These settings take effect when the server restarts. If it can't start with them (a port already in use, a certificate it can't get), put the old values back in config.yaml in the data folder.
settings.general.name: Server name
settings.general.nameBody: Shown in the apps when someone connects, on invites and in this console. Leave it empty for AudioSilo.
settings.general.public_urlBody: The address people use from outside your home, used in invite links and QR codes. Leave it empty to use whatever address the browser used.
settings.general.historyBody: Each listening session records the device and app it was on and the time of day. After this many days that detail is dropped and the session is added into daily totals per person and book, which the Activity pages keep.
settings.general.session_daysBody: From 30 to 3650. The default, 400, keeps a full year of detail for the Activity pages. A change applies at the server's next daily tidy-up.
settings.updates.title: Updates
settings.general.update_checkBody: Once a day the server asks GitHub Releases for the newest version. Only the request itself is sent (your server's address and its version); nothing about your library or people.
settings.updates.offBody: The server no longer contacts GitHub.
settings.network.httpsBody: How this server proves who it is to browsers and apps.
settings.network.mode.offBody: Plain HTTP. Only behind a reverse proxy that does HTTPS.
settings.network.mode.selfsignedBody: Encrypted, but browsers warn the first time. Fine for a home network.
settings.network.mode.autocertBody: Free trusted certificates, renewed automatically. Needs ports 80 and 443 open to the internet.
settings.network.tls_hostsBody: One per line, like books.example.com. Each must point at this server.
settings.network.cert.title: Certificate
settings.network.bindBody: The address and port the server listens on, like 0.0.0.0:8080. Change it only if something else uses the port.
settings.network.trusted_proxiesBody: Reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For header is believed, one address or range per line. Needed for correct addresses on devices and sessions.
settings.network.cors_originsBody: Other websites allowed to call this server's API, one per line. Usually empty.
settings.players.source.embeddedBody: This build carries the web player, so people can listen in a browser.
settings.players.source.dirBody: Served from the folder below, so people can listen in a browser.
settings.players.source.noneBody: This build has no web player and no player folder is set. The apps still work.
settings.players.web_dirBody: Set in config.yaml (web_dir) or AUDIOSILO_WEB_DIR. Takes effect at the next start.
settings.players.linksBody: Let invite links and QR codes open the installed app directly on your own domain. Only useful with an app build that claims this domain.
settings.players.apple_app_idsBody: Team ID and bundle ID, like ABCDE12345.app.audiosilo, one per line (Universal Links).
settings.players.android_sha256Body: SHA-256 of the app's signing certificate, one per line.
settings.metadata.base_urlBody: The community metadata service. Change it only if you run your own.
settings.metadata.matchingCardBody: How a community match picks between a recording's editions in different stores.
settings.metadata.regionBody: The store you buy from. When a recording sells in several, a match takes this store's ASIN.
settings.transcoding.cardBody: Converts formats browsers can't play (Opus, FLAC and others) to MP3 while someone listens. ffprobe reads lengths, chapters and codecs.
settings.transcoding.missing.ffmpeg: Not found, so books in formats browsers can't play won't play in the web player.
settings.transcoding.missing.ffprobe: Not found, so lengths and chapters come only from the files' tags.
settings.transcoding.how: The server finds ffmpeg and ffprobe when it starts: next to its own program, on the PATH, or downloaded into the data folder. Choose others with the --ffmpeg and --ffprobe options.
settings.demo.cardBody: Hands out throwaway accounts at /web/demo so people can try the player without signing up.
settings.demo.enabledBody: Also sends visitors of the site's front page straight to the demo.
settings.demo.libraryBody: The library every demo account gets.
settings.demo.max_usersBody: 0 means no limit. Leave it empty for the default.
settings.demo.idle_ttlBody: A length of time like 30m, 2h or 24h. Leave it empty for 24h.
system.title: System
system.description: Everything {{name}} depends on, in one place.
system.offline.body: Nothing was deleted: the server keeps every book, and people's progress, until the folder is back. Mount it again, then rescan.
system.metaDown.title: The community metadata service isn't responding
system.metaDown.body: Players still show what they already had. New matches wait until it's back; nothing to do unless this lasts a day.
system.detail.ffmpegDownloaded: Transcodes formats browsers can't play. Downloaded into the data folder.
system.detail.ffmpegMissing: Not found: formats browsers can't play won't play in the web player.
system.detail.ffprobeDownloaded: Reads lengths, chapters and codecs. Downloaded into the data folder.
system.detail.ffprobeMissing: Not found: lengths and chapters come only from tags.
system.detail.metadataOff: Turned off. No requests leave the server for it.
system.detail.metadataDown: Not responding. Players keep what they already had.
system.detail.tlsOff: Plain HTTP: a reverse proxy in front handles HTTPS.
system.detail.database: Schema {{schema}}. The book index can be rebuilt from your folders; accounts and progress can't.
system.detail.libraryOffline: Not reachable. Nothing is deleted while it's away.
about.title: About
about.description: Which AudioSilo this is, and whether a newer one exists.
about.off.title: The update check is off
about.off.body: Turn it on in Settings > General to hear about new versions. It asks GitHub Releases once a day.
about.available.title: AudioSilo {{version}} is available
about.how.docker: Pull the new image (ghcr.io/kodestar/audiosilo-server:{{version}}, or :latest) and recreate the container. Your data folder stays as it is.
about.how.binary: Download {{version}} for your system from the release page and replace the program, then start it again with the same data folder.
about.how.source: This is a local build: pull the {{version}} tag and build again.
about.failed.title: Couldn't check for updates
about.error.rate_limited: GitHub is limiting requests from this address for now. The server tries again tomorrow.
about.error.unreachable: GitHub couldn't be reached from the server. Check its internet connection.
about.error.bad_response: GitHub's answer didn't make sense. The server tries again tomorrow.
about.dev.title: This is a development build
about.dev.body: It can't be compared with releases. The newest release is {{version}}.
about.current.title: You're up to date
about.notChecked.title: Not checked yet
about.notChecked.body: The server checks a minute after it starts, then once a day.
about.fact.name: Name
logs.title: Logs
logs.description: What the server has been doing since it started, newest at the bottom.
logs.note: The server keeps its newest lines in memory, since it started. The full log is wherever its output goes (docker logs, or the terminal). Passwords, tokens and invite codes are never shown here.
system.detail.player.none: Not available. The apps still work.
system.detail.devBuild: A development build, so it isn't compared with releases.
shell.notifications.error: Notifications couldn't load. They'll try again in a minute.
shell.notifications.empty: Nothing yet. New books, offline libraries, new sign-ins, updates and failed backups show up here.
events.scan_failed.title: Scanning {{library}} failed
events.library_unavailable.title: {{library}} is offline
events.library_unavailable.body: Its folder can't be read. Nothing was removed: books and progress are kept until it's back.
events.new_device.title: New sign-in: {{user}}
events.invite_redeemed.title: {{user}}'s invite was used
events.update_available.title: AudioSilo {{version}} is available
events.backup_failed.title: A backup failed
settings.backups.scheduleBody: In the server's time zone. A backup missed while the server was off runs when it's back.
settings.backups.keepBody: The oldest scheduled backup goes when a new one is made. Manual backups stay until you delete them.
settings.backups.dirBody: Set in config.yaml (backups.dir) or AUDIOSILO_BACKUP_DIR. Copy backups to another disk now and then: a backup on the same disk as the server dies with it.
backups.why.title: The library index can be rebuilt. Your people's data can't.
backups.why.body: A backup is the server's database: accounts, progress, bookmarks, notes, metadata edits, shares, invites, devices and history. Books are read again from your folders after a restore. Settings in config.yaml aren't included.
backups.empty.title: No backups yet
backups.empty.next: The first scheduled backup runs {{when}}. Or back up now.
backups.empty.off: Scheduled backups are off. Back up now, or choose a schedule above.
backups.keepNote: Backups hold every account's password hashes: keep downloaded copies somewhere safe.
backups.failure.disk_full: The disk is full. Free some space; the next backup runs on schedule.
backups.failure.permission_denied: The server can't write to its backups folder. Check the folder's permissions.
backups.failure.failed: See Server > Logs for the cause.
backups.restore.title: Restore this backup?
backups.restore.body: When the server next starts, its database goes back to how it was on {{when}}: accounts, progress, bookmarks, edits, shares, invites and devices. Anything done since is lost.
backups.restore.point.copy: A copy of the current database is made first, so this can be undone by restoring that copy.
backups.restore.point.devices: Devices set up after this backup will need to sign in again.
backups.restore.point.config: Settings in config.yaml stay as they are.
backups.restore.scheduledBody: Restart AudioSilo to apply it. Until then nothing changes.
backups.restore.pendingTitle: A restore is waiting for a restart
backups.restore.pendingBody: When AudioSilo next starts it restores {{name}}, after keeping a copy of the current database. {{who}} asked for it on {{when}}.
backups.restore.doneBody: The database it replaced was kept as {{copy}}.
backups.restore.doneNoCopy: There was no database to keep a copy of.
backups.restore.failure.missing: The backup was gone when the server started. Nothing was changed.
backups.restore.failure.unusable: The backup turned out to be damaged. Nothing was changed.
backups.restore.failure.newer: The backup was made by a newer AudioSilo server. Update this one, then try again. Nothing was changed.
backups.restore.failure.failed: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed; see Server > Logs for the cause.
backups.delete.title: Delete this backup?
backups.delete.body: The backup from {{when}} is deleted from the server's folder. Copies you downloaded aren't affected.
notify.targetsBody: The same events always show in the bell at the top of this console.
notify.empty.title: No destinations yet
notify.empty.body: Send alerts to a webhook (Home Assistant, n8n...), an ntfy topic on your phone, or a Discord channel.
notify.privacy: Alerts carry names, counts and versions. Never a password, code, address or anything that lets someone in. Discord mentions are switched off, so a book title can't ping anyone.
notify.delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
notify.delete.body: Alerts stop going there. You can add it again any time.
notify.toast.addedBody: Send a test to check it works.
notify.kind.webhookBody: A JSON POST to any address, signed if you add a secret.
notify.kind.ntfyBody: Push notifications on your phone through an ntfy topic.
notify.kind.discordBody: A message in a channel, through the channel's webhook.
notify.reason.timeout: it took too long to answer
errors.invalid_target.kind_fixed: A destination's kind can't change. Add a new one instead.
errors.invalid_target.name_too_long: A name can be at most {{max}} characters.
errors.invalid_target.name_control: A name can't contain line breaks or control characters.
errors.invalid_target.url_required: Enter the address to send to.
errors.invalid_target.url_too_long: The address is too long (at most {{max}} characters).
errors.invalid_target.url_invalid: Enter an address starting with https:// or http://.
errors.invalid_target.url_ntfy: Enter the topic's address, like https://ntfy.sh/your-topic.
errors.invalid_target.secret_control: It can't contain line breaks or control characters.
errors.invalid_target.secret_discord: A Discord webhook takes no secret: its address is the secret.
errors.invalid_target.secret_again: Enter the secret again for the new address, or clear it.
errors.invalid_target.event_unknown: One of the events isn't known to this server.
notify.event.book_addedBody: Once per scan that finds new books, with a few titles.
notify.event.scan_failedBody: A library couldn't be scanned to the end.
notify.event.library_unavailableBody: Its folder can't be read (an unmounted drive). Once, until it's back.
notify.event.new_deviceBody: A password sign-in from a browser not seen before, or a newly paired device.
notify.event.invite_redeemedBody: A device was set up from an invite.
notify.event.update_availableBody: Once per new version, while the update check is on.
notify.event.backup_failedBody: A scheduled or manual backup failed.
notify.dialog.addBody: Where AudioSilo sends alerts. Its address is kept on the server and never shown again in full.
notify.dialog.name: Name
notify.dialog.urlHint.webhook: AudioSilo POSTs JSON here. A local address (http://192.168.1.5...) is fine.
notify.dialog.urlHint.ntfy: The ntfy server and topic, like https://ntfy.sh/your-topic. Pick a topic nobody can guess.
notify.dialog.urlHint.discord: In Discord: channel settings, Integrations, Webhooks, Copy webhook URL.
notify.dialog.urlKeep: Saved: {{address}}. Leave empty to keep it.
notify.dialog.urlRequired: Enter the address to send to.
notify.dialog.secretHint.signing: With a secret, each request carries an X-AudioSilo-Signature header the receiver can check.
notify.dialog.secretHint.token: For an ntfy server that needs a sign-in.
notify.dialog.secretKeep: A secret is saved. Leave empty to keep it.
audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: What admins changed, newest first. Kept for a year. Sign-ins are in People > Devices, listening in Activity, scans in Health > Jobs.
audit.empty.title: Nothing recorded yet
audit.empty.body: Changes made in this console (and with API keys) are listed here.
audit.emptyFiltered.title: Nothing matches
audit.emptyFiltered.body: Try another area, person or search.
eventsPage.title: Events
eventsPage.description: Everything the bell has shown, newest first. Kept for 90 days. Which events also reach your phone or chat is set in Settings > Notifications.
eventsPage.empty.title: Nothing yet
eventsPage.empty.body: New books, offline libraries, new sign-ins, updates and failed backups are listed here.
eventsPage.emptyFiltered.title: None of these in the last 90 days
audit.action.book.asin_repick: Looked for ASINs in the preferred store
audit.detail.name: Name
errors.backupRunning: A backup is already being made. Wait for it to finish.
errors.backupNotFound: That backup is gone. Refresh the list.
errors.invalidBackup: This file is damaged or isn't an AudioSilo backup, so it can't be restored.
errors.backupTooNew: This backup was made by a newer AudioSilo server. Update this one first.
errors.tooManyTargets: A server can have at most 20 notification destinations.
notify.dialog.secretAgain: This address is on another server: enter the secret again, or remove it.
backups.restore.point.revoked: Devices signed out and API keys revoked since the backup work again: sign them out again afterwards (People > Devices).
